identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Trial of TQ05105 Tablets Combined With TQB3909 Tablets in the Treatment of Myelofibrosis (MF)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ib/II Clinical Trial of TQ05105 Tablets Combined With TQB3909 Tablets in the Treatment of Moderate- and High-risk Myelofibrosis

statusModule.whyStopped: Per sponsor request. Premature closure was not prompted by any safety or efficacy concerns.

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open, single-arm, multi-center clinical study designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of TQ05105 tablets combined with TQB3909 tablets in patients with moderate- and high-risk Myelofibrosis.

primaryOutcomes.description: If dose limiting toxicity (DLT) occurs in 2 or more subjects in a given dose group, the dose level in the previous dose group is considered as MTD.
The RP2D is defined as the lower dose level to MTD based on the safety profile

primaryOutcomes.measure: 35% reduction in spleen volume (SVR35) at week 24
primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with a ≥35% reduction in spleen volume from baseline at the end of treatment at week 24

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with at least once spleen volume reduction ≥ 35% from baseline
The time interval from the first administration to the date when the spleen volume was reduced by ≥ 35 % from baseline

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of maintenance of at least 35% Reduction in Spleen Volume (DoMSR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The time between the date when the spleen volume reduction ≥ 35% from baseline occurs for the first time and the date when the spleen volume reduction is \< 35% from baseline.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage change in spleen volume from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage change in spleen volume of subjects from baseline after treatment.
The proportion of subjects with a ≥35% reduction in spleen volume compared to baseline after treatment at week 60.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Myeloproliferative neoplasm - Symptom Assessment Form - Total Symptom Score (MPN-SAF-TSS)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects whose total symptom score of MPN-SAF TSS decreased by more than 50% from baseline. MPN-SAF-TSS is a tool for evaluating the disease burden of patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms. Each symptom is scored according to the severity, from asymptomatic (0 points) to the most serious (10 points), a total of 10 levels, the sum of 10 symptom scores is MPN-SAF-TSS score. The higher the score, the more severe the symptoms are.
The time and duration when the MPN-SAF-TSS decreased by ≥50% compared to baseline for the first time.

The time interval from the first dose to the date of the occurrence of any of the following events, whichever occurs first:(1) Spleen volume increased by ≥25% compared with the screening period ; (2) Death caused by any cause.

The time interval from the date of the first dose to the date of any of the following events, whichever occurs first: (1) the date of the first bone marrow smear showing the original cell ≥20% ;(2) The first peripheral blood smear showed that the original cells ≥ 20% and the absolute value of the original cells ≥1×10\^9/L and lasted for at least 2 weeks; (3) Death caused by any reason.
The time from the first time the subject received treatment to death due to any cause

Incidence rate of all adverse medical events that occur after the subject receives the investigational drug, evaluated according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)

Severity of all adverse medical events that occur after the subject receives the investigational drug, evaluated according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)
